about: Iteration 1 hand-trace (git f9fdc6d, src/data/campus-{pois,lots,streets}.ts), converted back to fractions of the PATS Visitor Parking Map page: u = x / width, v = y / height. That trace was calibrated by clicking the page corners against the old CAMPUS_BOUNDS {minLat 32.7265, maxLat 32.733875, minLng -97.115286, maxLng -97.106994}, so u = (lng - minLng) / lngSpan and v = (maxLat - lat) / latSpan recover the page position, to the precision of those original clicks. Reference layer for the digitizer; never read by the app.
